text:
violet (partner-ops): We need a compact regional plan for the upcoming HW wave (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi). Partners ask for an explicit failover path if firmware/driver slips.
samir (partnerships): Proposal: NA primary, EU +7d, APAC +14d. Include explicit GA gating criteria per region.
eli (eng): Gating: 1) firmware microcode sign-off (MI300), 2) driver image verification (Gaudi), 3) telemetry flag validation (H200). If any missing, region gets "soft GA" with limited capacity.
mira (marketplace): Marketplace constraints: 14-day lead for verified images, and per-region metadata for power/thermal notes. Image verification queue is ~48h.
jon (solutions): For SIs: require perf cert + one dry-run day in staging. Recommend publishing both "nominal" and "derated" perf baselines so integrators know what to expect.
violet (partner-ops): Failover language idea: announce full specs in regions that meet gating; otherwise announce "availability with regional tuning" and list expected update window. Keeps comms clear without legal risk.
eli (eng): Risk items: if kernel bump misses by gating date, we must swap to older runtime and label as "compat mode". That costs ~10% perf but buys time.
mira (marketplace): Action: I'll create SKU templates with a "compat mode" flag and regional caveat text. ETA 72h.
samir (partnerships): Action owners: vendor commit ETA (violet) by Apr 22, eng gating checklist (eli) by Apr 20, marketplace templates (mira) in 72h, SI dry-run schedule (jon) by Apr 19.
press-ops: I'll draft two press blurbs: full-region GA and rolling-availability variant. Keep messaging neutral about "tuning".
violet (partner-ops): Okay: we'll push vendors for firm dates and publish the partner packet once gating checklist is green. If vendor misses Apr 22, switch to rolling-availability for APAC.
samir (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the partner packet owners and tag legal. :white_check_mark:
